title: Rectangular top images and Mal'tsev operations modulo the tops
claim: (1) In a law that composes like cycles, all nonempty fibres of a system's top image over the assignments to any fixed set of its variables have the same size. (2) So every top image is rectangular for every split of its variables. (3) Applying this to the system of ternary polymorphisms, as in the classical rectangularity argument, some ternary polymorphism F satisfies F(a,b,b) = a and F(a,a,b) = b modulo the top of the range generated by a and b, for all a and b of one sort. (4) On a knot range, every subrange that meets two top classes meets them all and carries the restricted top; so F is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range, which proves Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001. (5) A law composes like cycles exactly when every range with two or more values has a top, every tie's top image is a bijection, and some ternary polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range.
failure_conditions: A law that composes like cycles has a system whose top image has two nonempty fibres of different sizes over one set of variables, or is not rectangular for some split.
A law that composes like cycles has no ternary polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops of the generated ranges.
A subrange of a knot range meets two but not all top classes, or carries a top other than the restriction.
A law satisfies the three conditions of (5) but fails elimination, or composes like cycles and violates one of them.
foundation_claim_scope: Which laws compose like cycles: rectangular top images and Mal'tsev operations modulo the tops. No native recurrence, composed topology in the protected sense, path, metric distance or physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies uniform fibres and rectangularity on 1,680 top images of random systems over fourteen laws with census-certified tops, computes generated ranges exactly and finds and re-verifies a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the generated tops in six laws, checks Lemma 4 on every case and Corollary 6's conditions on the census laws; four controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with randomized and exhaustive checks; Theorem 2 of THOMSEN-KNOTS-20261021-001A-P001, the top lemma, Theorem 1 of KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001B-P001 and the classical rectangularity argument are cited; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: Lemma 1, Theorem 2, Lemma 4 and Corollaries 5 and 6 are new to the program, and with them Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 is proved; Theorem 3's step from rectangularity to an operation is the classical strong-rectangularity argument (Dyer and Richerby) read modulo the tops; no source found for the whole statement, folklore risk moderate.
